(* Solvent Dynamic Viscosity Approximation for Hydro-Alcoholic Phase (Water/Ethanol) *)
(* Polynomial fit around 20.0 deg C: eta(T, C_EtOH) in centipoise [cP] *)
rSolventDynamicViscosity_cP := 1.002 * (1.0 + (0.0245 * rEthanolConcentration_IR) - (0.0195 * (rProcessTemperature_degC - 20.0)));

    rSolventDynamicViscosity_cP := 0.65;

    rSolventDynamicViscosity_cP := 2.80;

    rEstimatedStokesDiameter_nm := (1.380649E-23 * (rProcessTemperature_degC + 273.15) * 1.0E12) /
                                   (3.0 * 3.14159265 * (rSolventDynamicViscosity_cP * 1.0E-3) * (rDLS_CorrelationDecayRate_Gamma * 1.85E-5));

    rFilteredDLS_Size_nm := (0.88 * rFilteredDLS_Size_nm) + (0.12 * rDLS_HydrodynamicDiameter);

    rFilteredDLS_Size_nm := rDLS_HydrodynamicDiameter;

rAct_EstimatedEncapsulation_pct := 98.5 - (18.5 * rDLS_NormalizedPDI) - (0.45 * ABS(rFilteredDLS_Size_nm - rTarget_ParticleSize_nm));

arrA_Matrix[1,1] := 0.985; arrA_Matrix[1,2] := 0.045; arrA_Matrix[1,3] :=-0.120; arrA_Matrix[1,4] := 0.000; arrA_Matrix[1,5] := 0.000; arrA_Matrix[1,6] := 0.000;

arrX_Pred[1] := (arrA_Matrix[1,1]*arrX_Est[1] + arrA_Matrix[1,2]*arrX_Est[2] + arrA_Matrix[1,3]*arrX_Est[3]) +

                (arrB_Matrix[3,1]*arrU_Prev[1] + arrB_Matrix[3,2]*arrU_Prev[2] + arrB_Matrix[3,3]*arrU_Prev[3]);

arrK_KalmanGain[1,1] := 0.245;
arrK_KalmanGain[2,2] := 0.185;
arrK_KalmanGain[3,3] := 0.320;

(*

====================================================================================================
Minimizes objective:
  J = sum(x^T * Q * x) + sum(u^T * R * u) + sum(delta_u^T * S * delta_u)
Subject to constraints:
  3.00 <= FRR <= 5.00
  10.0 <= TFR <= 120.0 mL/min
  0.0 <= Quench_Pump <= 350.0 mL/min
  0.0 <= TFF_Feed_Pump <= 100.0 %
  0.0 <= Retentate_Valve <= 100.0 %
Executed deterministically via projected gradient descent (max 8 iterations per PLC cycle).
*)

(* Tuning Weights *)

arrR_Weight[4] := 0.50; (* Cost on TFF Pump drive *)

arrU_Min[2] := 10.00;  arrU_Max[2] := 120.00; (* TFR [mL/min] *)
arrU_Min[3] := 0.00;   arrU_Max[3] := 350.00; (* Quench Flow [mL/min] *)

    arrU_Optimal[2] := arrU_Prev[2];
    arrU_Optimal[3] := arrU_Prev[3];
    arrU_Optimal[4] := arrU_Prev[4];
    arrU_Optimal[5] := arrU_Prev[5];

    (* Deterministic Projected Gradient Descent Loop *)
    FOR iMPC_Iteration := 1 TO 6 DO
        (* Calculate Objective Gradient: grad = B^T * Q * x_est + R * u + S * (u - u_prev) *)
        arrGradient[1] := (arrB_Matrix[1,1] * arrQ_Weight[1] * arrX_Est[1]) +
                          (arrB_Matrix[2,1] * arrQ_Weight[2] * arrX_Est[2]) +
                          (arrB_Matrix[3,1] * arrQ_Weight[3] * arrX_Est[3]) +
                          (arrR_Weight[1] * (arrU_Optimal[1] - rTarget_FRR)) +
                          (arrS_Weight[1] * (arrU_Optimal[1] - arrU_Prev[1]));

        arrGradient[2] := (arrB_Matrix[1,2] * arrQ_Weight[1] * arrX_Est[1]) +
                          (arrB_Matrix[2,2] * arrQ_Weight[2] * arrX_Est[2]) +
                          (arrB_Matrix[3,2] * arrQ_Weight[3] * arrX_Est[3]) +
                          (arrR_Weight[2] * (arrU_Optimal[2] - rTarget_TFR_mLmin)) +
                          (arrS_Weight[2] * (arrU_Optimal[2] - arrU_Prev[2]));

        arrGradient[3] := (arrB_Matrix[3,3] * arrQ_Weight[3] * arrX_Est[3]) +
                          (arrR_Weight[3] * arrU_Optimal[3]) +
                          (arrS_Weight[3] * (arrU_Optimal[3] - arrU_Prev[3]));

        arrGradient[4] := (arrB_Matrix[4,4] * arrQ_Weight[4] * arrX_Est[4]) +
                          (arrB_Matrix[5,4] * arrQ_Weight[5] * arrX_Est[5]) +
                          (arrR_Weight[4] * arrU_Optimal[4]) +
                          (arrS_Weight[4] * (arrU_Optimal[4] - arrU_Prev[4]));

        arrGradient[5] := (arrB_Matrix[4,5] * arrQ_Weight[4] * arrX_Est[4]) +
                          (arrR_Weight[5] * arrU_Optimal[5]) +
                          (arrS_Weight[5] * (arrU_Optimal[5] - arrU_Prev[5]));

        (* Descent Update: u = u - step * gradient *)
        arrU_Optimal[1] := arrU_Optimal[1] - (rMPC_StepSize * arrGradient[1]);
        arrU_Optimal[2] := arrU_Optimal[2] - (rMPC_StepSize * arrGradient[2]);
        arrU_Optimal[3] := arrU_Optimal[3] - (rMPC_StepSize * arrGradient[3]);
        arrU_Optimal[4] := arrU_Optimal[4] - (rMPC_StepSize * arrGradient[4]);
        arrU_Optimal[5] := arrU_Optimal[5] - (rMPC_StepSize * arrGradient[5]);

        (* Slew Rate Clamping *)
        IF (arrU_Optimal[1] - arrU_Prev[1]) > arrDeltaU_Max[1] THEN
            arrU_Optimal[1] := arrU_Prev[1] + arrDeltaU_Max[1];
        ELSIF (arrU_Optimal[1] - arrU_Prev[1]) < -arrDeltaU_Max[1] THEN
            arrU_Optimal[1] := arrU_Prev[1] - arrDeltaU_Max[1];
        END_IF;

        IF (arrU_Optimal[2] - arrU_Prev[2]) > arrDeltaU_Max[2] THEN
            arrU_Optimal[2] := arrU_Prev[2] + arrDeltaU_Max[2];
        ELSIF (arrU_Optimal[2] - arrU_Prev[2]) < -arrDeltaU_Max[2] THEN
            arrU_Optimal[2] := arrU_Prev[2] - arrDeltaU_Max[2];
        END_IF;

        IF (arrU_Optimal[3] - arrU_Prev[3]) > arrDeltaU_Max[3] THEN
            arrU_Optimal[3] := arrU_Prev[3] + arrDeltaU_Max[3];
        ELSIF (arrU_Optimal[3] - arrU_Prev[3]) < -arrDeltaU_Max[3] THEN
            arrU_Optimal[3] := arrU_Prev[3] - arrDeltaU_Max[3];
        END_IF;

        IF (arrU_Optimal[4] - arrU_Prev[4]) > arrDeltaU_Max[4] THEN
            arrU_Optimal[4] := arrU_Prev[4] + arrDeltaU_Max[4];
        ELSIF (arrU_Optimal[4] - arrU_Prev[4]) < -arrDeltaU_Max[4] THEN
            arrU_Optimal[4] := arrU_Prev[4] - arrDeltaU_Max[4];
        END_IF;

        IF (arrU_Optimal[5] - arrU_Prev[5]) > arrDeltaU_Max[5] THEN
            arrU_Optimal[5] := arrU_Prev[5] + arrDeltaU_Max[5];
        ELSIF (arrU_Optimal[5] - arrU_Prev[5]) < -arrDeltaU_Max[5] THEN
            arrU_Optimal[5] := arrU_Prev[5] - arrDeltaU_Max[5];
        END_IF;

        (* Box Constraint Projection *)
        IF arrU_Optimal[1] < arrU_Min[1] THEN arrU_Optimal[1] := arrU_Min[1]; END_IF;
        IF arrU_Optimal[1] > arrU_Max[1] THEN arrU_Optimal[1] := arrU_Max[1]; END_IF;

        IF arrU_Optimal[2] < arrU_Min[2] THEN arrU_Optimal[2] := arrU_Min[2]; END_IF;
        IF arrU_Optimal[2] > arrU_Max[2] THEN arrU_Optimal[2] := arrU_Max[2]; END_IF;

        IF arrU_Optimal[3] < arrU_Min[3] THEN arrU_Optimal[3] := arrU_Min[3]; END_IF;
        IF arrU_Optimal[3] > arrU_Max[3] THEN arrU_Optimal[3] := arrU_Max[3]; END_IF;

        IF arrU_Optimal[4] < arrU_Min[4] THEN arrU_Optimal[4] := arrU_Min[4]; END_IF;
        IF arrU_Optimal[4] > arrU_Max[4] THEN arrU_Optimal[4] := arrU_Max[4]; END_IF;

        IF arrU_Optimal[5] < arrU_Min[5] THEN arrU_Optimal[5] := arrU_Min[5]; END_IF;
        IF arrU_Optimal[5] > arrU_Max[5] THEN arrU_Optimal[5] := arrU_Max[5]; END_IF;
    END_FOR;
ELSE
    (* Fallback Deterministic Static Feedforward *)
    arrU_Optimal[1] := rTarget_FRR;
    arrU_Optimal[2] := rTarget_TFR_mLmin;
    arrU_Optimal[3] := rTarget_TFR_mLmin * 2.5; (* 2.5x dilution for quenching *)
    arrU_Optimal[4] := 45.0;                    (* Baseline 45% TFF feed pump *)
    arrU_Optimal[5] := 35.0;                    (* Baseline 35% retentate valve throttle *)
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
SECTION 5: IN-SITU ETHANOL QUENCHING MASS BALANCE DYNAMICS
====================================================================================================
*)
(* Mass Balance Calculation:
   C_post_quench = (Q_lipid * 100%) / (Q_aqueous + Q_lipid + Q_quench)
   Target is strictly < 9.5% v/v to preserve LNP bilayer architecture.
*)
IF (rAct_CalculatedTFR_mLmin + rQuenchBuffer_InletFlowRate) > 1.0 THEN
    rAct_PostQuenchEthanol_pct := (((rFlowRate_Lipid_ChA + rFlowRate_Lipid_ChB) * 0.5) * 100.0) /
                                  (rAct_CalculatedTFR_mLmin + rQuenchBuffer_InletFlowRate);
ELSE
    rAct_PostQuenchEthanol_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Quench Dosing Compensation: Auto-trim quench pump to cap ethanol at 9.0% *)
IF (rAct_PostQuenchEthanol_pct > 9.0) AND (iState = 50) THEN
    arrU_Optimal[3] := arrU_Optimal[3] + 5.0; (* Proactive dilution injection *)
    IF arrU_Optimal[3] > arrU_Max[3] THEN
        arrU_Optimal[3] := arrU_Max[3];
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
SECTION 6: CONTINUOUS TANGENTIAL FLOW FILTRATION (TFF) & DIAFILTRATION
====================================================================================================
*)
(* Transmembrane Pressure: TMP = ((P_feed + P_retentate) / 2.0) - P_permeate *)
rAct_TransmembranePressure_bar := ((rTFF_FeedPressure_PT201 + rTFF_RetentatePressure_PT202) * 0.5) - rTFF_PermeatePressure_PT203;
IF rAct_TransmembranePressure_bar < 0.0 THEN
    rAct_TransmembranePressure_bar := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Normalized Permeate Flux: J_p = Q_permeate [L/h] / Area [m2] *)
(* Convert mL/min to L/h: (Q * 60.0) / 1000.0 *)
IF rMembraneArea_m2 > 0.001 THEN
    rAct_PermeateFlux_LMH := ((rTFF_PermeateFlowRate_FT205 * 0.060)) / rMembraneArea_m2;
ELSE
    rAct_PermeateFlux_LMH := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Diafiltration Volume Integration: DV = Integral(Q_permeate * dt) / V_retentate *)
tPermeateIntegratorTimer(IN := NOT tPermeateIntegratorTimer.Q, PT := T#100MS);
IF tPermeateIntegratorTimer.Q AND (iState = 70) THEN
    (* 100 ms slice in minutes: 0.1 / 60.0 = 0.0016667 min *)
    rCumulativePermeateVolume_mL := rCumulativePermeateVolume_mL + (rTFF_PermeateFlowRate_FT205 * 0.0016667);
    IF rTFF_RetentateHoldVolume_mL > 5.0 THEN
        rAct_DiafiltrationVolumes_DV := rCumulativePermeateVolume_mL / rTFF_RetentateHoldVolume_mL;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Buffer Exchange Completion Ratio based on 2oo3 Voted Conductivity *)
IF (rInitialRetentateConductivity - rTarget_TargetConductivity_mS) > 1.0 THEN
    rBufferExchangeCompletionRatio := (rInitialRetentateConductivity - rAct_Voted_RetentateCond_mS) /
                                      (rInitialRetentateConductivity - rTarget_TargetConductivity_mS);
    IF rBufferExchangeCompletionRatio > 1.0 THEN
        rBufferExchangeCompletionRatio := 1.0;
    ELSIF rBufferExchangeCompletionRatio < 0.0 THEN
        rBufferExchangeCompletionRatio := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rBufferExchangeCompletionRatio := 1.0;
END_IF;

(* TMP Regulation PID Loop (Driving retentate backpressure valve) *)
rTMP_Error := rTarget_RetentateTMP_bar - rAct_TransmembranePressure_bar;
rTMP_IntegralAccumulator := rTMP_IntegralAccumulator + (rTMP_Error * 0.010);
IF rTMP_IntegralAccumulator > 30.0 THEN rTMP_IntegralAccumulator := 30.0; END_IF;
IF rTMP_IntegralAccumulator < -30.0 THEN rTMP_IntegralAccumulator := -30.0; END_IF;

rTMP_DerivativeValue := (rTMP_Error - rTMP_PrevError) / 0.010;
rTMP_PrevError := rTMP_Error;

(*
====================================================================================================
SECTION 7: MULTI-STAGE PROCESS FINITE STATE MACHINE (ISA-88 COMPLIANT)
====================================================================================================
*)
tStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPrevState), PT := T#24H);
tSubStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#24H);
iPrevState := iState;

CASE iState OF

    0: (* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 0: INITIALIZATION & SELF-DIAGNOSTIC TEST (POWER-ON POST)
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        sCurrentStateString := 'INITIALIZING_DIAGNOSTIC_POST';
        bSystemReady        := FALSE;
        bFormulationActive  := FALSE;
        bQuenchActive       := FALSE;
        bDiafiltrationActive:= FALSE;
        bCycleComplete      := FALSE;

        rCmd_AqueousPump_FlowRate     := 0.0;
        rCmd_LipidPump_FlowRate       := 0.0;
        rCmd_QuenchPump_FlowRate      := 0.0;
        rCmd_TFF_FeedPump_Speed       := 0.0;
        rCmd_TFF_RetentateValve_Pos   := 0.0;
        rCmd_TFF_DiafiltratePump_Flow := 0.0;

        (* Reset accumulators *)
        rCumulativePermeateVolume_mL := 0.0;
        rAct_DiafiltrationVolumes_DV := 0.0;
        rFilteredDLS_Size_nm         := rTarget_ParticleSize_nm;
        rDLS_NormalizedPDI           := 0.05;

        IF bExecute AND (NOT bEmergencyStopActive) AND (NOT bAlarmActive) THEN
            iState := 10; (* Proceed to Standby & Thermal Conditioning *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 10: STANDBY & THERMAL JACKET EQUILIBRATION
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        sCurrentStateString := 'STANDBY_THERMAL_EQUILIBRATION';

        (* Closed loop Peltier thermal jacket regulation *)
        rTemp_Error := 20.0 - rProcessTemperature_degC; (* Target 20.0 deg C *)
        rTemp_IntegralAccumulator := rTemp_IntegralAccumulator + (rTemp_Error * 0.010);
        IF rTemp_IntegralAccumulator > 50.0 THEN rTemp_IntegralAccumulator := 50.0; END_IF;
        IF rTemp_IntegralAccumulator < -50.0 THEN rTemp_IntegralAccumulator := -50.0; END_IF;
        rCmd_ThermalJacket_DutyCycle := (rTemp_Kp * rTemp_Error) + (rTemp_Ki * rTemp_IntegralAccumulator);

        IF rCmd_ThermalJacket_DutyCycle > 100.0 THEN rCmd_ThermalJacket_DutyCycle := 100.0; END_IF;
        IF rCmd_ThermalJacket_DutyCycle < 0.0 THEN rCmd_ThermalJacket_DutyCycle := 0.0; END_IF;

        (* Check thermal tolerance (+/- 1.5 deg C) and 2oo3 sensor health *)
        IF (ABS(rProcessTemperature_degC - 20.0) < 1.5) AND
           (NOT bPT101_TotalFailure) AND (NOT bPT102_TotalFailure) AND (NOT bAT204_TotalFailure) THEN
            bSystemReady := TRUE;
            IF bExecute THEN
                iState := 20; (* Advance to Hydraulic Prime *)
                iSubState := 0;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            bSystemReady := FALSE;
        END_IF;

    20: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 20: SOLVENT LINE PRIME, DE-AIRING & LEAK TEST
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        sCurrentStateString := 'LINE_PRIME_AND_DEAIRING';

        CASE iSubState OF
            0: (* Prime Aqueous Manifold with Citrate Buffer *)
                rCmd_AqueousPump_FlowRate := 5.0; (* 5 mL/min flush *)
                rCmd_LipidPump_FlowRate   := 0.0;
                rCmd_QuenchPump_FlowRate  := 15.0;
                IF tStateTimer.ET > T#10S THEN
                    iSubState := 1;
                END_IF;

            1: (* Prime Lipid Line with 100% Pure Ethanol *)
                rCmd_AqueousPump_FlowRate := 5.0;
                rCmd_LipidPump_FlowRate   := 1.25;
                rCmd_QuenchPump_FlowRate  := 20.0;
                IF tStateTimer.ET > T#20S THEN
                    iSubState := 2;
                END_IF;

            2: (* Pressure Hold & Pressure Decay Leak Check *)
                rCmd_AqueousPump_FlowRate := 0.0;
                rCmd_LipidPump_FlowRate   := 0.0;
                rCmd_QuenchPump_FlowRate  := 0.0;
                (* Verify inlet pressures are holding without gross manifold seal breach *)
                IF (rAct_Voted_MixerPressure_bar < 0.8) AND (rAct_Voted_LipidPressure_bar < 0.8) THEN
                    iState := 30; (* Proceed to Dynamic Ignition *)
                    iSubState := 0;
                ELSIF tStateTimer.ET > T#35S THEN
                    dwAlarmVector_ISA18_2 := dwAlarmVector_ISA18_2 OR 16#00000010; (* Priming Overpressure *)
                    iState := 900;
                END_IF;
        END_CASE;

    30: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 30: JET IMPINGEMENT FLOW STARTUP & DYNAMIC FRR RAMP (IGNITION)
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        sCurrentStateString := 'IMPINGEMENT_IGNITION_AND_RAMP';

        (* Avoid microfluidic mixer channel clogging by launching aqueous flow 250 ms ahead of lipid *)
        CASE iSubState OF
            0: (* Aqueous Initial Leading Jet Wave *)
                rCmd_AqueousPump_FlowRate := rTarget_TFR_mLmin * (rTarget_FRR / (rTarget_FRR + 1.0));
                rCmd_LipidPump_FlowRate   := 0.0;
                rCmd_QuenchPump_FlowRate  := rTarget_TFR_mLmin * 2.5;
                IF tStateTimer.ET > T#500MS THEN
                    iSubState := 1;
                END_IF;

            1: (* Synchronized Lipid Injection & Soft FRR Ramp *)
                rCmd_LipidPump_FlowRate := rTarget_TFR_mLmin / (rTarget_FRR + 1.0);
                rCmd_AqueousPump_FlowRate := rTarget_TFR_mLmin * (rTarget_FRR / (rTarget_FRR + 1.0));
                rCmd_QuenchPump_FlowRate  := rTarget_TFR_mLmin * 2.5;
                bFormulationActive := TRUE;
                bQuenchActive := TRUE;

                (* Verify flow stability *)
                IF (ABS(rAct_CalculatedFRR - rTarget_FRR) < 0.35) AND
                   (ABS(rAct_CalculatedTFR_mLmin - rTarget_TFR_mLmin) < 3.5) THEN
                    iState := 50; (* Transition to Closed-Loop Production *)
                    iSubState := 0;
                ELSIF tStateTimer.ET > T#15S THEN
                    dwAlarmVector_ISA18_2 := dwAlarmVector_ISA18_2 OR 16#00000020; (* Startup Flow Convergence Failure *)
                    iState := 900;
                END_IF;
        END_CASE;

    50: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 50: CLOSED-LOOP STEADY-STATE LNP SYNTHESIS & IN-LINE PAT OPTIMIZATION
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        sCurrentStateString := 'STEADY_STATE_SYNTHESIS_MPC_ACTIVE';
        bFormulationActive := TRUE;
        bQuenchActive := TRUE;

        (* Apply MPC Optimized Manipulated Variables *)
        rCmd_AqueousPump_FlowRate := arrU_Optimal[2] * (arrU_Optimal[1] / (arrU_Optimal[1] + 1.0));
        rCmd_LipidPump_FlowRate   := arrU_Optimal[2] / (arrU_Optimal[1] + 1.0);
        rCmd_QuenchPump_FlowRate  := arrU_Optimal[3];

        (* Store control actions for slew penalty evaluation *)
        arrU_Prev[1] := arrU_Optimal[1];
        arrU_Prev[2] := arrU_Optimal[2];
        arrU_Prev[3] := arrU_Optimal[3];
        arrU_Prev[4] := arrU_Optimal[4];
        arrU_Prev[5] := arrU_Optimal[5];

        (* Check Surge Accumulator for downstream TFF transition *)
        IF bEnableContinuousTFF AND (rTFF_RetentateHoldVolume_mL >= 25.0) THEN
            iState := 70; (* Activate Simultaneous Diafiltration *)
            iSubState := 0;
        END_IF;

    70: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 70: CONTINUOUS TANGENTIAL FLOW FILTRATION (TFF) DIAFILTRATION
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        sCurrentStateString := 'CONTINUOUS_TFF_DIAFILTRATION_EXCHANGE';
        bFormulationActive   := TRUE;
        bQuenchActive        := TRUE;
        bDiafiltrationActive := TRUE;

        (* Maintain upstream synthesis commands from MPC *)
        rCmd_AqueousPump_FlowRate := arrU_Optimal[2] * (arrU_Optimal[1] / (arrU_Optimal[1] + 1.0));
        rCmd_LipidPump_FlowRate   := arrU_Optimal[2] / (arrU_Optimal[1] + 1.0);
        rCmd_QuenchPump_FlowRate  := arrU_Optimal[3];

        (* TFF Recirculation Feed Pump Speed *)
        rCmd_TFF_FeedPump_Speed   := arrU_Optimal[4];

        (* Sanitary Retentate Backpressure Valve modulated by TMP PID + MPC feedforward *)
        rCmd_TFF_RetentateValve_Pos := arrU_Optimal[5] - (rTMP_Kp * rTMP_Error) - (rTMP_Ki * rTMP_IntegralAccumulator) - (rTMP_Kd * rTMP_DerivativeValue);
        IF rCmd_TFF_RetentateValve_Pos > 100.0 THEN rCmd_TFF_RetentateValve_Pos := 100.0; END_IF;
        IF rCmd_TFF_RetentateValve_Pos < 5.0 THEN rCmd_TFF_RetentateValve_Pos := 5.0; END_IF;

        (* Constant-Volume Diafiltration Buffer Dosing:
           Dosing pump matches permeate flux rate exactly to preserve constant retentate volume *)
        rCmd_TFF_DiafiltratePump_Flow := rTFF_PermeateFlowRate_FT205;

        (* Evaluate Diafiltration Exchange Endpoint:
           Criteria: >= Target Diafiltration Volumes (e.g. 6.0 DV) AND Conductivity <= Target (e.g. 1.2 mS/cm) *)
        IF (rAct_DiafiltrationVolumes_DV >= rTarget_DiafiltrationVolumes) AND
           (rAct_Voted_RetentateCond_mS <= (rTarget_TargetConductivity_mS + 0.20)) AND
           (rAct_PostQuenchEthanol_pct < 0.50) THEN
            iState := 80; (* Transition to Batch Finishing & Cryo Concentration *)
            iSubState := 0;
        END_IF;

    80: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 80: FINAL CONCENTRATION, CRYOPROTECTANT CHASE & RECOVERY
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        sCurrentStateString := 'BATCH_FINISHING_AND_RECOVERY';
        bDiafiltrationActive := TRUE;

        (* Gracefully ramp down upstream microfluidic formulation *)
        rCmd_AqueousPump_FlowRate     := 0.0;
        rCmd_LipidPump_FlowRate       := 0.0;
        rCmd_QuenchPump_FlowRate      := 0.0;
        bFormulationActive            := FALSE;
        bQuenchActive                 := FALSE;

        (* Stop diafiltration dosing buffer to allow final volume concentration *)
        rCmd_TFF_DiafiltratePump_Flow := 0.0;

        (* Concentrate down to target retentate hold-up volume (e.g. 15.0 mL) *)
        IF rTFF_RetentateHoldVolume_mL <= 15.0 THEN
            rCmd_TFF_FeedPump_Speed     := 0.0;
            rCmd_TFF_RetentateValve_Pos := 100.0; (* Drain relieve *)
            bDiafiltrationActive        := FALSE;
            bCycleComplete              := TRUE;
            iState := 100; (* Proceed to Standby Complete / CIP *)
        END_IF;

    100: (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 100: BATCH COMPLETED / CIP & MEMBRANE INTEGRITY READY
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        sCurrentStateString := 'CYCLE_SUCCESSFUL_SYSTEM_IDLE';
        bSystemReady        := FALSE;
        bFormulationActive  := FALSE;
        bQuenchActive       := FALSE;
        bDiafiltrationActive:= FALSE;
        bCycleComplete      := TRUE;

        rCmd_AqueousPump_FlowRate     := 0.0;
        rCmd_LipidPump_FlowRate       := 0.0;
        rCmd_QuenchPump_FlowRate      := 0.0;
        rCmd_TFF_FeedPump_Speed       := 0.0;
        rCmd_TFF_RetentateValve_Pos   := 100.0;
        rCmd_TFF_DiafiltratePump_Flow := 0.0;

        IF bCIP_Initiate THEN
            iState := 110; (* Clean In Place / Water-Flux Integrity Routine *)
        ELSIF NOT bExecute THEN
            iState := 0;   (* Reset to uninitialized upon command removal *)
        END_IF;

    110: (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 110: CLEAN-IN-PLACE (CIP) & NORMALIZED WATER PERMEABILITY (NWP)
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        sCurrentStateString := 'SANITARY_CIP_AND_MEMBRANE_NWP_CHECK';

        (* Flush caustic / WFI across TFF membrane to verify cleanliness *)
        rCmd_TFF_FeedPump_Speed       := 30.0;
        rCmd_TFF_RetentateValve_Pos   := 40.0;
        rCmd_TFF_DiafiltratePump_Flow := 20.0;

        IF tStateTimer.ET > T#60S THEN
            rCmd_TFF_FeedPump_Speed       := 0.0;
            rCmd_TFF_RetentateValve_Pos   := 100.0;
            rCmd_TFF_DiafiltratePump_Flow := 0.0;
            iState := 0; (* Cycle back to base state *)
        END_IF;

    900: (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 900: EMERGENCY DEPRESSURIZATION, FAULT ISOLATION & CONTAINMENT
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
        sCurrentStateString := 'EMERGENCY_DEPRESSURIZATION_AND_TRIP';
        bSystemReady        := FALSE;
        bFormulationActive  := FALSE;
        bQuenchActive       := FALSE;
        bDiafiltrationActive:= FALSE;
        bCycleComplete      := FALSE;
        bAlarmActive        := TRUE;

        (* Total actuator safe state *)
        rCmd_AqueousPump_FlowRate     := 0.0;
        rCmd_LipidPump_FlowRate       := 0.0;
        rCmd_QuenchPump_FlowRate      := 0.0;
        rCmd_TFF_FeedPump_Speed       := 0.0;
        rCmd_TFF_RetentateValve_Pos   := 100.0; (* Fully vent retentate *)
        rCmd_TFF_DiafiltratePump_Flow := 0.0;
        rCmd_ThermalJacket_DutyCycle  := 0.0;

        (* Latch until master operator reset asserted *)
        IF bReset AND (NOT bEmergencyStopActive) THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(*
====================================================================================================
SECTION 8: ISA-18.2 / NAMUR NE 107 ALARM HIERARCHY & PROCESS INTERLOCKS
====================================================================================================
*)
(* Alarm 1: Mixer Channel Overpressure Trip (PT-101 > 4.20 bar) *)
tAlarmDebounce_Overpressure(IN := (rAct_Voted_MixerPressure_bar > 4.20) OR (rAct_Voted_LipidPressure_bar > 4.20), PT := T#80MS);
IF tAlarmDebounce_Overpressure.Q THEN
    bLatch_Overpressure_Trip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmVector_ISA18_2 := dwAlarmVector_ISA18_2 OR 16#00000100; (* Overpressure Critical *)
    iState := 900;
END_IF;

(* Alarm 2: Polydispersity Index Severe Aggregation Trip (PDI > 0.18 for > 3.0 s) *)
tAlarmDebounce_HighPDI(IN := (rDLS_NormalizedPDI > 0.180) AND (iState = 50), PT := T#3000MS);
IF tAlarmDebounce_HighPDI.Q THEN
    bLatch_HighPDI_Trip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmVector_ISA18_2 := dwAlarmVector_ISA18_2 OR 16#00000200; (* LNP Size Aggregation Warning/Trip *)
    iState := 900;
END_IF;

(* Alarm 3: TFF Membrane Fouling / Severe Transmembrane Overpressure (TMP > 2.60 bar) *)
IF (rAct_TransmembranePressure_bar > 2.60) AND (iState = 70) THEN
    bLatch_HighTMP_Trip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmVector_ISA18_2 := dwAlarmVector_ISA18_2 OR 16#00000400; (* TFF Fouling Trip *)
    iState := 900;
END_IF;

(* Alarm 4: In-Situ Quench Breakthrough (Ethanol > 12.0% v/v in post-quench flow) *)
tAlarmDebounce_EthanolBreak(IN := (rAct_PostQuenchEthanol_pct > 12.0) AND (iState = 50), PT := T#500MS);
